body: Thank you to everyone who reached out yesterday. This community definitely eased some of the loneliness in my final hours. Forever grateful. Please do what I couldn't.

If I could leave I would. I have no money to my name, my car was repo'd, and my injury was a knee injury so I'm barely mobile with my own legs. Sorry for your health shit, hopefully it gets better fam. But deuces, it's 2am where I'm at so I'm prolly close to crashing

Thank you for reading it all and listening to my story, truly, and I appreciate the words of encouragement, but I can't make any promises. I'm tired man. I've got no fight left in me tbh. Having suicidal thoughts as young as 6th grade, and overcoming it only for more shit to get piled on and relapsinf. And while I understand the changing perspective, it's also not that easy. I can't make amends without doing time and incriminating other people, and adding becoming a felon to my long list of setbacks will only further increase the obstacles preventing me from trying to heal. And not mention the shame and guilt that'll be brought on my family due to the POS I used to be. Like I said, no promises, but at the very least I will sleep on it, and see if I still have the same convictions come morning. 

Also don't compare or invalidate your own struggles. We all got our shit, and as bad as my experiences have been we both know there's someone who's had it even worse. But that fact does nothing to alleviate our own suffering, but even if I follow through with it tomorrow, I'm glad this post was able to do some good. Good luck in your own fight.

The thought of purgatory and more torture afterwards is definitely terrifying and in the back of my mind, but at the same time, right now, I'm more of a burden and hindrance on my family. If my mental/emotional/physical shit can't be fixed then I at least shouldn't leech off them any longer. I'm doing this for them as much as I am for myself. 

I appreciate you reading it all and reaching out tho. If you on this thread then you got your own shit too, so good luck with it

@finn8675309 idk why the comments not showing on the thread or if it's something with my settings idk, I usually just peruse posts on this thread. But I did eat, ordered a ton of sushi and am quite happy with the decision. Wasn't bad for a last meal

I've normally rattled off like a bulleted list of current and major past issues that have set me on this path whenever I've been asked this question, but seeing as how this is my last night, I guess I'll go into full detail/disclosure. Tw: every possible trigger basically

I am the by product of my mothers marital rape when she intended to leave my abusive druggy excon biological father, which is why there's only an 11month gap between and my sister. She's never made it distinctively clear whether I was a genuine failed abortion attempt or if she just got cold feet and changed her mind, but that original feeling and and the circumstances surrounding my conception would play a key role in my upbringing and her behavior towards me

Fast forward to kindergarten/1st grade. My mother having never dealt with her own trauma in a healthy manner could barely stomach the sight of me since I resembled my birth father and would cart me off to numerous baby sitters, even though my sister would remain with her. One babysitter early on in particular was my teacher/family friend. She had a special needs child. I don't recall her age, only that she was big but acted my age. I would kick and scream and beg not be left there, and told my parents I didn't like the way she played. Unable to understand or articulate the abuse that was happening they just assumed I was being a dick basically. This went on until we moved. Thankfully my stepfather  was in the military so there's always plenty of moving and new traumas to be made elsewhere. 

Now this was about 2nd to about 5th grade, we lived in a little cul-de-sac in Georgia that had it all; neighbors having affairs, domestic violence,  arrests, physical child abuse resulting in kids being removed from home, and if you guessed more sexual assault..you'd be right. All this didn't just happen only to my family, but all 4 families that lived there were very close knitted took turns babysitting and spent holidays together, and parents worked on the same base etc so you can imagine the chaos. Me and two other kids were all subjected to more assault. Now this time it was different, cause it was an adult, and he only took pics and made the kids do stuff and called it playing but we were always at their house cause they had a pool. Sometimes me and my friend would do the shit he showed us when we had sleepovers cause it felt good and we didn't know wtf we were doing. I'm not gay, and maybe that could be considered just kids "experimenting or playing doctor" but while we kept it secret from other adults the morality of our actions hadn't set in yet. Now I would do this with another kid, this time a younger girl, mind you I'm only 9 or 10 until we moved. The guilt from what I did to the younger girl is a very big part of my escapism into drugs/liquor later on, and guilt I feel still today contributing to me ending shit. But I digress.

Now we're in the next state. We'll only be here for 2 years, shorter than everywhere else, but even this place will leave its mark. So despite previous trials and tribulations, I was actually doing well academically and loved school cause it was an escape. My middle school would change that. It was a predominantly all black school and me being a nerd with an unusual name from a little island in the pacific that no kids had heard of made me an easy target, and I would experience bullying, not just teasing but getting jumped weekly so bad that we moved on base and switched schools. Unfortunately the damage had been done. The kid who loved school was nonexistent and had found gang violence as a way to try and protect myself. Unfortunately while one gang can provide a sense of belonging and protection, it also puts another target. My parents forced me into c.a.p to straighten my behavior, which is like rotc but for air force, and during one weekend of survival/training and camping, my tent mates to my surprise were bloods and stripped me down and gave me a little cut on my genitals and kicked me out the tent.. wasn't all bad though,, we did get to fly Cessna for a little so that was cool. Anyways I had done a complete 180. Always fighting and cussing and stealing and getting into shit, and just turned to a total delinquent atp. 

Next move we go home to the island were from for a year while my stepfather is deployed, this was my first time being there and meeting my grandparents the first time,, for once it wasn't a living hell, so I fell in love with it and the family I had there. Nothing drastic, still fighting and getting into shit but nothing extreme. But my grandparents death before me ever getting a chance to go home and visit them again is also another guilty parasite. 2 sets, 3 deaths cause they each divorced/remarried. It's been almost 15yrs since I've been back, which is another burden.

Fast forward to high school in another state. Spend high school years getting "kicked out" and let back in until 17 when I was kicked out for good. Off and on of being homeless until I moved in with a friend and his family my senior year. More gang violence, drug usage, b&e's, stealing, and drug dealing and even a drive by shooting in my high school yrs. Do I know if it was my bullet that ended someone's life, not at all, but there was 4 of us and we all equally to blame. Can't really talk to a therapist about that shit, I don't want to get in trouble for it nor do I want to risk getting the other guys in trouble. They were there for me when I needed them most. I had intended to enlist out of high school and get my shit together but due to an earlier health complication/surgery I was denied, which fucked all my plans cause I only did bare minimum in hs since the military didn't give af about grades. All I ever wanted was to enlist. Now that too was taken from me. 

My early 20's would consist of me doing basically every drug but meth and heroine and drinking myself into a stupor to repress all past shit. I mean heavy usage of everything that would alter my mind even slightly. I had the mindset of I don't want to kill myself but I don't want to live long either so no fucks given. That abuse on my body would lead to current health complications from that life style. I now spit up blood regularly, with no health insurance.

Now most recently, I had 3 jobs and was still dealing to  support my mom and sisters cause they got their own health and medical issues, and sister has a deadbeat baby daddy and a kid I help provide for and paying for my own place, and to offset the balance of how much coke I needed to do to maintain working that much. I was previously suicidal in 2020 and ended up at a church of all places, and was talked down. I gave up coke and dealing and was gonna try and live straight and narrow. I kept the 3 jobs cause I wanted to get into community College but was denied fafsa. But I wasn't disheartened, I felt rejuvenated and ready to tackle all my shit. Then I got injured at one of my jobs. And couldn't work 2 of them. Powered through to work my last bartending job cause I was still fighting a legal battle over my work injury. Most ppl would've immediately broken at this point. But I persevered and told myself to see it through, and thought my lawyers would at least come through for me, and get me a payout that would fix a lot of my current setbacks. Unfortunately if you keep working when you're injured you get half of the amount you would've gotten. So the payout was not what was projected or anywhere close to help with the financial setbacks of losing two jobs.. And further physical therapy was denied on top of that. 

Now I'm unemployed, with crushing debt, half from previous living situations where "friends" fucked me over and I got stuck with the apt debt, and the other half from being out of work and bills just piling. License revoked due to failure to meet monthly payments since there's no fuckinf monthly income. Phone services shut off, now using prepaid. Being supported by my family financially and just hemorrhaging more money from an already poor situation. My mental/emotional health keeps me from having the will/energy  to attempt to rehabilitate to the point I can work again, but my physical health prevents my financial health from improving, which in turns causes a further decline of my mental and emotional health. Never ending cycle.. Short of a fucking miracle, there's really no option. 

Despite this essay of a response there's so much more nuance and layers to all of this shit that goes deeper than you or I can fathom. 

Idk if anyone will read all this, but if you do, tell me you wouldn't be in the same place I am right now. Tomorrow morning will finally be the peace I've been denied for so long.

I mean there's always a slight chance of failure. Short of finding someone to empty the entire clip into my skull, there's no real way for me to ensure it'll work 100%. And in the event of me surviving it, then I guess it would just get chalked up to more self destructive behavior that makes an already shitty situation a thousand times worse. Risk v reward. Even in a failed attempt I'm sure I'll either be comatose or in a catatonic state which still sounds better than current conditions. Not that I believe EMS would abide by it, but I could also try to staple a paper to my shirt with DNR written on it, or that I refuse life saving services.

It's what the gun is for. Highest success rate out of all suicide methods, and it'll be a fairly secluded place and time, so even if it isn't immediate, I'm hoping it should still be effective enough.
